mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the past 2 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2% YoY, it signals a period of accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% YoY signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing by more than 3% YoY, it signals a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.
